svg.title: Mechanical engineering student / France
svg.desc: Mechanical engineering student / France I'm not a developer; I love coding in my free time, especially where software, hardware, and music meet. Still a Padawan, always learning. I write my contributions to other people's repositories myself. Some of my personal projects are vibe-coded with AI, including OSCMidi.
